title: Tracking the Scent to Phase Two — Part 6

series.summary: Gon confesses to Kurapika the terrifying thrill of confronting Hisoka. Tracking Leorio's cologne through the mist, they reach the Second Phase site at Biska Forest Park, where Gourmet Hunters Menchi and Buhara unveil an unexpected cooking exam.

segments.voiceover_text: Rejoining Kurapika on the mossy ground, a trembling Gon catches his breath. He confesses that facing Hisoka brought paralyzing terror, but also an intoxicating rush of excitement.
With the examiner long gone, Gon uses his sharp sense of smell to track Leorio's cologne, guiding Kurapika straight through the thinning swamp fog.
They emerge into the sunlight of Biska Forest Park, reuniting with Killua. Nearby, Leorio nurses a black eye, completely baffled about how he arrived.
The estate gates swing open to reveal Gourmet Hunters Menchi and Buhara. To everyone's shock, the second phase of the exam is a cooking test.
